findings.reason: the plan states the cross-project reader is wider only because the grant holds no project, so it should say the fallback scopes by project where a project is supplied and reads across projects only when it is None, or the delivery reader can be handed another project's run.
findings.text: the remedy has the durable reader select rows by the `node` column across projects and places the fallback inside `_resolved_reviewed_run_id`, whose other four callers (recovery_review_delivery.py:118 and :233, recovery_review_dispatch.py:180, promotion_checks.py:2343) each pass a real project, and whose live path scopes by that project through `list_live(project=...)` (reckon/crew/runs.py:720); as written a project-bearing caller whose source node id finds no live pointer can resolve to a same-named node's run in another project, which the live path would never return

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every anchor resolves: `_resolved_reviewed_run_id` at reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py:220, `round_node_head_suffix` at reckon/crew/repair.py:331, `_run_head_for_review` at reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:577, `RunStore` in reckon/run_store.py (with the `node` column already declared and indexed in `QUERY_KEYS`), and every named existing test file; the one missing test file is the new one this node creates.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §3's five cases are each falsifiable and it declares two negative controls (remove the durable fallback; return the newest durable match rather than the head-suffix match), each run alone under pytest with a failing test id.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate runs in the foreground, both arms' logs land in the run directory, and the manifest's `baseline_suite` names the base log and its failure ids.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test path and every symbol named are mechanism-descriptive; no plan label, ticket number or version tag reaches code.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §3 resolves the durable fallback by the `node` column across projects without the project the resolver is already given, so the durable path is wider than the live path it stands behind.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §3 carries one deliverable, resolving a promoted run's review over the durable run records; the "After it lands" command is a verification step, not a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the reopened document is coherent: `plan-status` returns to `active` with `s3: implementable`, the one declared `plan-section-depends-on` edge (`s2 → s1`) resolves, and §3 needs no new edge because the sections it shares a file with (§1, §2) are already `done`.
